question:
Which of the following statement is correct?

I. The value of 100² - 99² + 98² - 97² + 96² - 95² + 94² - 93² + ...... + 22² - 21² is 4840.

II. The value of 

 ( {{k²}+(1)/({{k²)}}} )( {k - (1)/(k)} )( {{k⁴}+(1)/({{k⁴)}}} )( {k+(1)/(k)} )( {{k⁴}-(1)/({{k⁴)}}} ) is k¹⁶ - (1)/(k¹⁶⁾.
solution:
Given:

I. The value of 1002 - 992 + 982 - 972 + 962 - 952 + 942 - 932 + ...... + 222 - 212 is 4840.

II. The value of 

 ( {{k²}+(1)/({{k²)}}} )( {k - (1)/(k)} )( {{k⁴}+(1)/({{k⁴)}}} )( {k+(1)/(k)} )( {{k⁴}-(1)/({{k⁴)}}} ) is k16 - (1)/(k¹⁶⁾.

Concept used:

A, (A + D), (A + 2D), ....., L is an arithmetic progression with the first term A and common difference D. (L being the Nth term)

Number of terms, N = (L - A)/D + 1 [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==] [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==] 

Sum of all terms = (A + L)/2 × N

Calculation:

II. ​According to the concept,

1002 - 992 + 982 - 972 + 962 - 952 + 942 - 932 + ...... + 222 - 212

(100 + 99)(100 - 99) + (98 + 97)(98 - 97)+...........(22 + 21)(22 - 21)

So, the series will be

100 + 99 + 98 + 97 .............................................22 + 21.

The first term is 100 and the last is 21, the difference is 1.

Sum = (100 + 21) × 80/2 = 121 × 40 = 4840

II. ( {{k²}+(1)/({{k²)}}} )( {k - (1)/(k)} )( {{k⁴}+(1)/({{k⁴)}}} )( {k+(1)/(k)} )( {{k⁴}-(1)/({{k⁴)}}} )

⇒ (k + frac {1}{k}) (k - frac {1}{k}) (k² + frac {1}{k²}) (k⁴ + frac {1}{k⁴}) (k⁴ - frac {1}{k⁴})

⇒ (k² - frac {1}{k²}) (k² + frac {1}{k²}) (k⁴ + frac {1}{k⁴}) (k⁴ - frac {1}{k⁴})

⇒ (k⁴ - frac {1}{k⁴}) (k⁴ + frac {1}{k⁴}) (k⁴ - frac {1}{k⁴})

⇒ (k⁸ - frac {1}{k⁸}) (k⁴ - frac {1}{k⁴}) ≠ (k¹⁶ - frac {1}{k¹⁶}) 

**∴ Only I is true.**
